description: This file defines a Java class MessageOnlyLogFilter that implements the LogNode interface. It acts as a filter in a logging chain, passing only the message content and omitting metadata like priority, tag, and throwable. It can be chained with other LogNode instances for logging purposes, particularly useful for displaying simple log messages on-screen without detailed metadata.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class that processes log messages, passing only the message text to the next LogNode.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes a log message, forwarding only the message content to the next node.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
